Welcome to Countryside Veterinary Services— home to Countryside Animal Hospital and Countryside Equine Hospital. We provide compassionate, comprehensive care for dogs, cats, and horses.
From advanced diagnostics to expert medical, surgical, and dental treatment, we’re here to help your animals live long, healthy, happy lives.

Our facilities feature:
✅ In-house labs
✅ Radiograph & ultrasound imaging
✅ Multiple endoscopy technologies
✅ Fully equipped surgical suites
✅ Well-stocked pharmacies
✅ Safe, closely monitored hospitalization & boarding areas

Whether it’s routine wellness or complex diagnostics, we’re your trusted partner in lifelong care.

🔍 Progressive Medicine. Exceptional Care. Real Answers.

Subscribe for behind-the-scenes footage, expert tips, how-to tutorials, and stories from the heart of veterinary life.
